context: Sakura visits an art museum with Aoi; aesthetic discussion.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: The museum visit is really nice, isn't it?
lines.style: Open, genuinely interested. Warm gaze at the work. Slight smile in the voice. Conversational but not rushed — letting the moment breathe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: This piece is really striking — the way the tools are used is so distinctive.
lines.style: Quiet observation, as if thinking aloud. Soft attentive tone. Eyes still on the work. Noticing something true, not performing depth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: You can really feel the personality in it.
lines.style: Soft certainty. Slight lean forward. Voice carries genuine recognition — like she's been waiting for permission to say this out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 哲学的な作品ね、同じくらい、深い。
lines.en: It's philosophical in a way, you know? Just as deep as it needs to be.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. No rush. Warm and conversational, not lecturing. A thought shared quietly between two people really looking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: たった、一つの作品で、こんなに考える。
lines.en: It's amazing how much one piece can make you think.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the voice. Almost to herself but spoken aloud. A small awe — the kind that doesn't need performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: The way it's presented is so delicate.
lines.style: Appreciative murmur. Noticing the care behind the curation. Warm, genuine — the voice of someone who sees the work behind the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft contentment. A glance toward Aoi. Simple honesty — not effortful, just true. Trailing warmth.
